answer: Proposal: each claim needs a fresh hardware attestation for one chip ID; the chain enforces one account per chip. Software secrets split like shale — one purchase, endless copies — but a sealed key never leaves its silicon island: copying it means shipping the chip. Costs ripple per head: N masks need N chips or N rented enclaves, honestly linear; a farm profits only while a head's lifetime reward tops its rental bill. Cap rewards under that and every extra mask loses. It removes free identities, not wealth. Vendor issues one key per chip; a leak breaks it.
